mobile.accounts.browser_waiting: Finish signing in on {{server}}'s page. The app continues on its own once you're done.
mobile.accounts.fetch_keys_hint: Messages that couldn't be decrypted can be read once their keys come from your key backup. This happens on its own after verifying; try it again if some still can't be read.
mobile.accounts.license: Free software under the MIT license
mobile.accounts.maps_hint: Shared places show their name and coordinates, without a map. Nothing is loaded from OpenStreetMap.
mobile.accounts.maps_on_hint: Maps of shared places load from OpenStreetMap, which sees your device’s IP address and the area shown.
mobile.accounts.no_code: The server didn't send a link or code.
mobile.accounts.notifications_hint: When rooms notify you, unless a room has its own setting. Change a single room from its menu. Saved on your homeserver, so your other apps follow it.
mobile.accounts.sign_out_hint: Its messages and keys are removed from this device. Keep your recovery key or another signed-in session, so you can read your encrypted messages after signing in again.
mobile.accounts.third_party_hint: The main libraries Better Matrix is built with, each with its version and license.
mobile.accounts.verify_person_waiting: Waiting for {{name}} to accept the request…
mobile.accounts.verify_person_incoming: {{name}} wants to verify with you, from {{device}}.
mobile.accounts.verify_person_compare: Check that {{name}} sees the same emoji, in the same order.
mobile.accounts.verify_person_done: You verified {{name}}. You'll be warned if their identity changes.
mobile.accounts.verify_show_code: Scan this code with your other device.
mobile.accounts.verify_show_or_scan: Scan this code with your other device, or scan the code it shows.
mobile.accounts.verify_scan_only: Scan the code your other device shows.
mobile.accounts.verify_person_show_or_sc: Ask {{name}} to scan this code, or scan theirs.
mobile.accounts.verify_scanned: Does your other device say it scanned the code?
mobile.accounts.verify_person_scanned: Does {{name}}'s device say it scanned the code?
mobile.accounts.qr_scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code.
mobile.accounts.qr_camera_denied: Better Matrix may not use the camera. Allow it in Settings to scan the code.
mobile.accounts.qr_camera_needed: Scanning the code needs the camera.
mobile.accounts.offline_hint: The server keeps a device for your account, so a session you sign in to later can read messages sent while none was signed in. Turning it on needs your recovery key.
mobile.accounts.offline_key_message: Enter your recovery key to turn it on.
mobile.accounts.keys_hint: Move the keys to your encrypted messages to another app or session as a file, protected with a passphrase.
mobile.accounts.export_hint: The file holds the keys to every encrypted message this session can read. Choose a passphrase to protect it; importing the file needs it.
mobile.accounts.import_message: Enter the passphrase the file was exported with.
mobile.accounts.imported.one: {{imported}} of {{count}} key was new to this session.
mobile.accounts.imported.other: {{imported}} of {{count}} keys were new to this session.
mobile.accounts.password_hint: Your other sessions are signed out once the password changes.
mobile.accounts.deactivate_hint: Closes the account for good on its server.
mobile.accounts.deactivate_body: Nobody can sign in to it again, you included, and its user ID can't be used again. This can't be undone. Erasing your messages asks the server to hide them from people who join later; those who already have them keep them.
mobile.accounts.deactivate_password: Enter your password to deactivate the account.
mobile.accounts.link_device_hint: Sign in on a new phone or computer with a QR code. It starts verified.
mobile.accounts.link_show_hint: On the new device, choose to sign in with a QR code and scan this code.
mobile.accounts.link_scan_hint: Scan the QR code the new device shows.
mobile.accounts.link_done: The new device is signed in.
mobile.accounts.qr_enter_check_code: Enter the two digits the other device shows.
mobile.accounts.qr_check_code: Enter this code on the other device:
mobile.accounts.qr_approve: Approve the new sign-in on your account page, then come back here.
mobile.accounts.qr_waiting: Approve this sign-in on your other device.
mobile.accounts.qr_waiting_code: Approve this sign-in on your other device. Its page shows the code {{code}}.
mobile.accounts.sign_in_qr_scan_hint: On a device where you're signed in, open Settings, then Sessions, Link a new device and Show QR code. Scan that code here.
mobile.accounts.sign_in_qr_show_hint: On a device where you're signed in, choose to link a new device by scanning a QR code, and scan this one.
mobile.accounts.registration_token_hint: {{server}} asks for a registration token to create an account.
mobile.accounts.terms_hint: Read and agree to {{server}}'s policies to continue:
mobile.accounts.registration_browser: Finish this step on {{server}}'s page in your browser, then continue here.
mobile.accounts.registration_email_hint: {{server}} asks for an email address to create an account. It sends a link there to confirm it.
mobile.accounts.registration_email_inval: Enter an email address like name@example.org.
mobile.accounts.registration_email_sent: We sent a link to {{address}}. Open it, then continue here.
mobile.accounts.registration_email_uncon: {{server}} hasn't seen the link opened yet. Open the link in the email, then continue again.
mobile.accounts.qr_failed: Signing in with the QR code didn't finish.
